messages:
noah: Quick thread to lock down postmortem follow-ups for the GPU surge. I'll enumerate actions; please claim and drop ETA.

anya: I'll take the temporary quota request + infra ticket. ETA: Fri EOD. Need the exact current pool numbers to file.

lee: I'll own scheduler changes and a canary. Plan: small bump to scheduler.max_pending +10% and reduce batch_window_ms from 60->35 for hot routes. Canary on gpu-canary-x. ETA: Tue COB.

noah: Snapshot for ticket: reserved=72 GPUs, 1m peak=110 GPUs, headroom target=18% (~13 GPUs) but observed ~3-4 GPUs.

anya: For the infra form I'll paste: "Observed repeated short spikes that exceeded reserved pools, leading to scheduling backpressure. Request temporary soft quota to restore targeted headroom while we validate autoscaler + scheduler fixes."

devops-bot: Created INFRA-830 (quota request) -> https://tracker.internal/INFRA-830. Assigned to anya.

lee: Canary details: deploy tuning to gpu-canary-x, run 20-30m load replay, check p95 latency, pending queue depth, and schedule failures. Rollback criteria: p95 > baseline*1.12 or schedule failures +25. Will attach script.

noah: Telemetry owner? We need 1m rolling headroom, model-level QPS, and an alert when headroom <10% for 3m. Also link the alert to paging.

anya: ops-bot, can you add a recurring check-in calendar for 4 weeks? We'll meet short weekly to look for recurrence.

ops-bot: Recurring event "GPU surge follow-ups" created Wednesdays 09:30 UTC for 4 weeks.

lee: I'll also add a smoke test to the PR that fails the canary if CPU/GPU steal > baseline + 10. ETA Tue.

noah: Runbook owner? Need a concise step-by-step: scale reserved pool, enable temp quota, roll back tuning.

anya: Tess has been working on runbooks—@tess, can you claim?

ops-bot: Note: tess not present in participants; add if claiming.

noah: OK, let's finalize ETAs here: anya (quota) Fri 18:00 UTC; lee (scheduler canary) Tue COB; telemetry owner to confirm ETA in thread; runbook will be PR'd by tess if she claims. We'll use this thread as canonical register until tickets close.

ops-bot: Incident summary added to INFRA-830: GPU surge 2026-05-14 02:12 UTC. Open actions INFRA-830 (quota), INFRA-831 (scheduler canary), INFRA-832 (telemetry), INFRA-833 (runbook).
